title: Campus Lost & Found
description: A full-stack web application that streamlines the recovery of lost belongings by allowing users to submit reports, manage item listings, search matches, and facilitate communication between finders and owners.

title: Computer Network Chat Server
description: A real-time networking application developed in C++ that allows multiple clients to connect, exchange messages, and communicate through a centralized server while demonstrating socket programming, concurrency, and network protocol implementation.

title: Wilder Cards
description: An AI-powered mobile app that lets users photograph plants and animals, identifies the species, delivers detailed info, and turns nature-watching into a fun, gamified learning journey.

title: EduChat
description: A real-time chat app for classrooms with secure logins, class-specific rooms, and instant text or image sharing.

title: Balance Buddy
description: A personal finance tracker with real-time balance, simple +/- amount description input, editable and deletable transactions, and clear income/expense indicators.

title: Selamna Hiwet Ministries (Ongoing)
description: Selamna Hiwet Ministries' website is a purpose-driven platform built to share vision, foster community, and enable meaningful support. It features intuitive menu navigation, multilingual content (English, Tigrinya), clearly laid-out information about ministries, programs, and humanitarian outreach, leadership bios and history to build trust—and prominent buttons or links that invite visitors to donate, volunteer, or partner.
